spot_ema_moves_faster.meaning: short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into the longer-horizon EMAs

twap_feeds_liquidation.meaning: the TWAP from twapEMA() is used in PanopticPool.getTWAP() and feeds liquidation solvency checks and the StaleOracle gate

stale_gate_outcome_matches_intended.meaning: the StaleOracle gate outcome (revert when stale, proceed when not stale) matches the outcome that would be produced by evaluating against the intended smoothed TWAP
stale_gate_outcome_matches_intended.checkpoint: after twapEMA computation, at StaleOracle gate evaluation

claims.scope: RiskEngine.twapEMA() computes a TWAP from OraclePack.getEMAs() return values; that TWAP feeds PanopticPool.getTWAP() and downstream liquidation solvency checks, StaleOracle gate, and premium/force-exercise pricing

preconditions.text: Short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into the longer-horizon EMAs; The TWAP from twapEMA() is used in PanopticPool.getTWAP() and feeds liquidation solvency checks (atTicks[1] = twapTick) and the StaleOracle gate |currentTick - twapTick| > tickDeltaLiquidation
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The StaleOracle gate |currentTick - twapTick| > tickDeltaLiquidation should evaluate against the intended smoothed TWAP so it reverts when stale and proceeds when not stale
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Outcomes of the StaleOracle safety boundary and solvency evaluation are altered; the system may proceed when it should revert as stale, or revert when it should proceed
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The StaleOracle gate and solvency evaluation consume the TWAP returned by twapEMA() via PanopticPool.getTWAP().
The report does not fix whether the gate proceeds or reverts in a specific case; the relation is stated as correspondence to the intended smoothed-TWAP outcome.

limitations: Only the v_stale_oracle_outcome impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The intended smoothed TWAP blend (6*fastEMA + 3*slowEMA + eonsEMA)/10 is not encoded as a numeric identity because the selected impact is the gate-outcome correspondence, not the blend formula.
